About.Headline: Deep backend at scale. Now bringing AI into it.
Paragraphs: I'm a senior software engineer with 9+ years building reliable, high-performance systems in .NET and .NET Core — distributed systems, microservices, and the kind of data-heavy services that have to stay fast under real load.

My work has centered on systems where correctness and latency matter: a licensing platform fielding roughly 20k requests per second, a service that materialises a 1.8M-user, ~6GB repository in under a minute with sub-10ms average response on hot paths, and 20+ systems delivered and maintained. I led the access-service rebuild — delivered on time, with a strong reliability record — and I mentor the engineers around me.

Now I'm pointing that systems background at AI. I build applied-AI features on the cloud, work through cloud AI certification paths, and I'm fluent with agentic developer tooling. The goal isn't AI for its own sake — it's bringing AI capabilities into systems that already have to be reliable.

There's an embedded thread running underneath all of this. I'm an IoT hobbyist — ESP32, Arduino, MicroPython — which means I tend to understand systems from the silicon up. That perspective, from sensor telemetry to distributed services, is where I do my best work.
